update_up_to_date: You are on the latest version.
update_available_body: Version {version} is available. Install and restart now.
update_error: Could not check or install updates. Confirm the GitHub release endpoint and updater public key are configured.
update_unavailable: Updates are available only in the desktop application.
empty_gallery: No folders or images in this location.
empty_filter: No items match the current search or filter.
empty_browser: Open the desktop application to browse your Pictures folder.
onboarding_body: Gallery opens your Pictures folder by default. Open subfolders from the grid to browse. Image files stay on your device.
ext_face_body: Optional local add-on. A face detector and an embedding model group people on this computer. Photos are not uploaded.
ext_install_confirm_body: Gallery will download the signed package into this app data folder on your computer. Photos are not uploaded. Install only if you want local face grouping.
ext_uninstall_confirm_body: This removes the installed package from the app data folder. Face groups on this computer stay until you clear them separately.
ext_unavailable_toast: No installable package is available right now.
ext_no_host: No signed package is published yet. You can install a folder from this computer.
ext_not_published: No signed package is published yet. You can install a folder from this computer.
ext_mode_hint: Automatic updates run only after you install this extension.
ext_registry_error: Could not refresh the signed extension catalog.
ext_downgrade: A newer version is already installed.
ext_revoked: This package was revoked. Remove it, then install a newer signed package when one is published.
ext_app_too_old: Update Gallery before installing this extension.
ext_experimental_required: Enable recognition before indexing faces. Install the extension first.
ext_catalog_not_loaded: The signed catalog is not loaded yet. Check for updates.
ext_no_artifact: No package is published for this computer. Linux x86_64 is the published target.
ext_runtime_missing: This computer's recognition runtime is not in the installed package.
ext_install_error: Could not install that package. Check the manifest and file hashes.
ext_flag_error: Could not update the experimental setting.
ext_desktop_only: Extensions are available only in the desktop application.
edit_quality_enhance_help: Enhance means a larger Lanczos resize, a stronger unsharp mask, and more contrast. It does not generate new image content.
edit_replace_blocked: Replace keeps the current format. Save as new to convert.
edit_not_raster: This file cannot be edited as a raster image.
edit_err_target_exists: A file with that name already exists. Choose another name.
edit_err_too_large: This image is too large to edit.
edit_err_crop: The crop rectangle does not fit inside the image.
edit_err_extension: The file name extension must match the output format.
edit_err_name: Enter a file name in this folder.
edit_err_invalid: Check the crop, resize, and quality values.
edit_gif_note: GIF edits use the first frame.
edit_lossless_note: This format does not use a quality setting.
edit_enhance_note: Enhance applied upscale, sharpen, and contrast.
edit_reduce_auto_note: Auto reduce searched for a smaller JPEG.
edit_target_not_met: The file is still larger than the maximum byte target.
edit_webp_note: WebP output is lossless with the current encoder, so a quality number is not applied.
copy_confirm: Save a copy of this image beside the original?
copy_clipboard_ok: Image copied. Paste it in another app.
rename_ext_help: The extension stays fixed. Convert with Edit image and Save as new.
rename_exists: A file with that name already exists.
rename_extension: Rename keeps the original extension. Use Save as new to convert.
delete_confirm_body: Delete {name} permanently from this computer? This cannot be undone.
edit_save_as_ext_help: Extension follows the output format and cannot be edited here.
reorder_help: Drag images, or press Alt and an arrow key, to set a manual order.
reorder_error: Could not save the image order.
reorder_blocked: Clear search and the type filter before reordering.
people_empty: No people are grouped yet. Faces appear here as this folder is indexed on this computer.
people_empty_indexing: Looking for faces in this folder. People appear here as they are found.
people_hint: Recognition stays on this computer. Photos are not uploaded.
people_done: Indexing finished. {scanned} images checked, {skipped} unchanged, {faces} faces recorded.
people_cancelled: Indexing stopped. Faces already saved stay on this computer.
people_truncated: Indexing stopped at the folder limit. Open a smaller folder to continue.
people_name_hint: Leave the name empty and save to clear it.
people_detail_empty: No photos are linked to this person yet.
